You are a careful, neutral coder of the REALIZED OUTCOME of a corporate transaction
over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

rationale: 2-4 sentences citing the slice lines that drove your p4_pathway and
p5_pathway codes specifically. Cite ONLY realized-outcome evidence; do NOT reason
about how the deal was structured at closing.

Emit ONLY the structured record. Code conservatively: absence of documented
evidence for a pathway is 0 (not-documented); inability to determine is "uncertain".

# Outcome sub-dossier — Molycorp, Inc. realized record after the ~2016 reorganization, ~3-5-year horizon

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. Because the registrant was dissolved and
> deregistered as part of its reorganization, there is no post-closing public periodic
> report for the analyzed entity; the realized-record facts below are limited to what the
> entity's own final filings establish. This sub-dossier contains no information about how
> the transaction was structured at closing.

## Public-reporting status after the transaction (feasibility-relevant)
- On August 31, 2016 the registrant filed a Form 15 (Rule 12g-4(a)(1) and Rule 12h-3(b)(1)(i)) certifying termination of registration and suspension of its duty to file reports for its common stock and its 6.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2017, 5.50% Convertible Senior Notes due 2018, and 10% Senior Secured Notes due 2020. [SRC: SEC accession 0001489137-16-000121, Form 15-12B]
- The Form 15 reports the approximate number of holders of record as "none" for each covered class as of the notice date, and states that upon effectiveness of the plan all previously issued equity securities of Molycorp, Inc. were cancelled and extinguished. [SRC: SEC accession 0001489137-16-000121, Form 15-12B]
- The registrant's EDGAR filing history for CIK 1489137 shows no annual report (Form 10-K) or other periodic report filed after the August 31, 2016 emergence and Form 15; the last substantive current reports are the 2016 filings surrounding emergence. [SRC: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=1489137&type=10-K&dateb=&owner=include&count=40]

## Realized record of the analyzed entity
- Molycorp, Inc. was dissolved on the plan's effective date and its equity was cancelled without distribution to equity holders; the surviving downstream businesses passed to a separate newly created reorganized parent and the Mountain Pass mineral rights and process IP passed to a separate buyer, so the registrant that carried CIK 1489137 did not continue as a reporting operating company after August 31, 2016. [SRC: SEC accession 0001489137-16-000120, Form 8-K Item 1.03]
- Consequently there is no audited public financial statement, impairment, divestiture, or other realized operating scalar attributable to the analyzed entity for the ~2019–2021 outcome window (three to five years after the ~2016 transaction). [SRC: SEC accession 0001489137-16-000121, Form 15-12B]

## Items noted but not primary-verifiable for the analyzed entity
- The successor businesses continued under separate ownership after 2016 (the downstream units under a lender-owned reorganized parent; the Mountain Pass mineral rights and IP under a separate buyer), but any post-2016 operating results of those successor entities are recorded under different registrants/private ownership and are not attributable to the analyzed entity's public record; no such successor-specific scalar is asserted here. [UNVERIFIED]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Because Molycorp, Inc. was dissolved and deregistered as of its August 31, 2016 emergence — equity cancelled, duty to file reports terminated by Form 15, and no periodic report filed thereafter — there is no public 3-5-year operating record for the analyzed entity, and the outcome is coded UNCERTAIN (no public record) rather than inferred from any successor's results. [SRC: SEC accession 0001489137-16-000121, Form 15-12B] [SRC: SEC accession 0001489137-16-000120, Form 8-K Item 1.03]

[SLICE END]
